files.description: EHI Export Documentation for IntelleChartPRO (ICP) platform. 6-page PDF describing ZIP export structure, folder layout, file formats (JSON/XML/PDF), CCDA data classes, auditing, and handling of encounters, documents, and images.

Data dictionary for ICP EHI export. 19 sheets covering Appointments, ChartNote, Communications, Documents, Glaucoma Flowsheet, Images, Insurance & Auth, Internal Communication, Laboratory, Patient Demographics (71 fields), Procedures, Referrals, Refractions, Retina Injection Log, Shared Care Comments, Secure Messages, Specialty Medications, and Tasking. 341 total fields.

EHI Export Documentation for Nextech Select/NexCloud platform. 8-page PDF describing ZIP export structure with CSV clinical data, EMN PDFs, Documents folder, iPad Documents, CCDA. Includes billing data (charges, payments, payment plans), custom data, internal messaging (PracYakker), recalls, and iPad-specific exports.

Data dictionary for Nextech Select/NexCloud EHI export. 16 sheets covering Charges (140 fields), Patient Demographics (212 fields), Appointments (52 fields), Payments (50 fields), Insurances (85 fields), EMN, Notes, Custom, Follow up, Recalls, Recalls Steps, Payment Plans, PracYakker, DSI feedback, iPad Tasks, iPad Notes. 730 total fields — the most detailed of the three dictionaries.

EHI Export Documentation for SRSPro platform. 8-page PDF describing ZIP export structure with CSV/XML clinical discrete data, Documents folder, Encounter Data Capture XMLs, CCDA. Includes detailed notes on family history, diagnoses, orders/results relationships, implantable devices, and document handling.

Data dictionary for SRSPro EHI export. 19 sheets covering Appointments, Custom Alerts, Diagnoses (35 fields), Family History (3 related CSVs), Implantable Devices (35 fields), Injections (36 fields), Guarantor Information, UDFs, Insurance Information (38 fields), Smoking Status (58 fields), Orders (86 fields), Messages, Medications (CCDA), CodeSystemNames, Encounter Data Capture (405-row XML schema), Vitals (XML), Results (XML with 327 rows). 427 total fields.
Full-page screenshot of the EHI Export Documentation landing page showing all three platform sections with download links.
Bun TypeScript script that parses all three XLSX data dictionaries into a single queryable JSON file. Extracts entity names, export formats, field definitions, and summary statistics.
Queryable JSON output containing all 54 entities and 1498 fields across three platforms (ICP: 19 entities/341 fields, SRSPro: 19 entities/427 fields, NexCloud/Select: 16 entities/730 fields).
Documentation for the enrichment scripts: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
